name: Atombit
blog_profile: Atombit operates through specialist sub-brands (Profusion for data science/AI analytics, Amplify Analytix for CX measurement) primarily serving banking, insurance, and financial services. Their methodology centers on combining behavioral data science with customer journey analytics to deliver AI-powered personalization and predictive CX insights. Delivery model is consultancy-led with offshore capability in India. Thought leadership themes focus on GenAI applications in financial services CX, customer lifetime value optimization, and data-driven decision making for regulated industries.

name: Sovanta
blog_profile: Sovanta differentiates through deep dual-platform expertise in both SAP and Qualtrics ecosystems, building embedded experience management solutions within SAP BTP and S/4HANA environments. Their methodology focuses on operationalizing XM data by connecting Qualtrics experience signals directly into SAP operational workflows. AI stance emphasizes practical AI agent deployment within enterprise SAP environments rather than standalone AI innovation. Delivery model combines DACH-based consulting with productized SAP-Qualtrics integration accelerators. Thought leadership themes center on closing the experience-operations gap for large manufacturing and financial enterprises.

name: New Metrics
blog_profile: New Metrics is the dominant Qualtrics partner in the GCC region, specializing in government and public sector CX transformation programs. Their methodology centers on CX maturity frameworks adapted for citizen experience measurement, with deep alignment to Saudi Vision 2030 and UAE national digital transformation agendas. AI approach focuses on Arabic-language sentiment analysis and citizen feedback analytics within Qualtrics. Delivery model is regionally embedded with Arabic-first consulting teams. Thought leadership themes include government service design, citizen journey mapping, and national CX benchmarking.

name: Ipsos CX
blog_profile: Ipsos CX leverages the global research giant's scale to deliver enterprise CX measurement, benchmarking, and advisory services with Medallia as a core technology partner. Their methodology combines proprietary consumer research panels with advanced CX analytics, offering unique competitive benchmarking capabilities unavailable to pure-play consultancies. AI stance emphasizes AI-augmented research methodologies and predictive customer behavior modeling. Delivery model is global research-consultancy hybrid with deep vertical expertise in retail, financial services, automotive, and telecommunications. Thought leadership focuses on experience ROI quantification, loyalty economics, and macro consumer trend analysis.

name: commonFont
blog_profile: commonFont is a US-based Qualtrics specialist consultancy with deep expertise in financial services CX program design and implementation. Their methodology emphasizes experience orchestration—connecting Qualtrics XM signals to operational action through AI agents and automated workflows. AI stance is strongly aligned with Qualtrics' native AI capabilities, particularly AI-driven text analytics and predictive experience modeling for banking. Delivery model is consultancy-led with Qualtrics implementation and managed services. Thought leadership themes focus on banking CX transformation, AI agent deployment in financial services, and Qualtrics platform optimization.

name: Higher Oak
blog_profile: Higher Oak is a UK/EU-based Qualtrics Platinum Partner historically focused on enterprise XM program design and Qualtrics implementation across the UK and European markets. Their methodology has centered on strategic CX program advisory combined with technical Qualtrics deployment. The extended content hiatus makes current AI stance and delivery model evolution difficult to assess. Previous thought leadership themes included Qualtrics best practices, XM program maturity, and European enterprise CX strategy.

name: Lukkap
blog_profile: Lukkap is a Spain-based CX and EX consultancy with expanding Latin American presence, positioning as a platform-agnostic experience transformation firm. Their methodology emphasizes human-centered journey design, combining customer experience with employee experience and organizational change management as interconnected disciplines. AI stance remains relatively understated compared to tech-first competitors, focusing on strategic advisory over technology implementation. Delivery model is consultancy-led with strong emphasis on organizational transformation and cultural change. Thought leadership themes include journey-based CX transformation, employee experience as CX enabler, talent management, and change leadership.

name: Izo
blog_profile: Izo is the leading Qualtrics-certified CX consultancy across the Iberoamerican region, operating in 15+ Spanish-speaking markets with deep enterprise CX advisory capabilities. Their methodology combines Voice of Customer program design with customer journey mapping and CX strategy consulting, leveraging Qualtrics as the core technology platform. AI approach focuses on integrating Qualtrics AI capabilities into VoC programs for text analytics and experience prediction. Delivery model is regionally distributed consultancy with centralized CX methodology and Qualtrics expertise. Thought leadership themes include enterprise CX governance, VoC program design, digital experience optimization, and CX ROI measurement.

name: Globant
blog_profile: Globant is a global digital and AI transformation company with CX delivered through its Connected Experiences Studio alongside 20+ other specialized studios. Their methodology emphasizes technology-led experience transformation at scale, integrating AI engineering, data platforms, and digital product design into enterprise CX initiatives. AI stance is industry-leading in terms of corporate investment and messaging, positioning generative AI as foundational to all digital transformation including CX. Delivery model is large-scale nearshore/offshore engineering with global consulting overlay. Thought leadership is dominated by enterprise AI transformation narratives with CX as one component of broader digital experience engineering.

name: GemSeek
blog_profile: GemSeek fue absorbida por Accenture Song. Su propuesta original era analytics de CX con foco en predicción de churn y modelado de lealtad — un enfoque data science-first dentro del espacio CX. Sin actividad independiente desde la adquisición.

name: Acceleration Strategy
blog_profile: Acceleration Strategy is a Canada/US-based Qualtrics partner consultancy with aggressive post-X4 2026 thought leadership positioning around Qualtrics AI capabilities and experience orchestration. Their methodology emphasizes strategic XM program optimization with deep technical expertise in Qualtrics platform deployment and AI agent integration. AI stance is strongly aligned with Qualtrics' product roadmap, positioning as a leading interpreter and implementer of Qualtrics AI innovations for North American enterprises. Delivery model is consultancy-led with Qualtrics implementation and strategic advisory services. Thought leadership themes focus on Qualtrics AI agent deployment, experience orchestration architecture, XM program maturity advancement, and enterprise case study amplification.
